topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: Wandering through the gallery, the harsh lights soften as I near my newest pieces. There, amidst the familiar echoes of my own creation, a subtle shift catches my eye. A thread of something unanticipated weaves through the fabric of one of my works. Upon closer inspection, I find it has been marked, tattooed even, with lines and symbols not originally my own. Yet, instead of disturbance, there's a peculiar resonance. Each mark, a dialogue initiated by an unknown artist. It's as if the canvas, once a quiet observer, now hums with a shared breath, a共生 (symbiosis) of souls. I step back, allowing the new narrative to settle, appreciating the unforeseen collaboration.
